title: Early experiments in accelerating science with GPT-5
summary: OpenAI introduces the first research cases showing how GPT-5 accelerates scientific progress across math, physics, biology, and computer science. Explore how AI and researchers collaborate to generate proofs, uncover new insights, and reshape the pace of discovery.
body: OpenAI introduces the first research cases showing how GPT-5 accelerates scientific progress across math, physics, biology, and computer science. Explore how AI and researchers collaborate to generate proofs, uncover new insights, and reshape the pace of discovery.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于GPT-5在科学研究领域应用的早期实验案例。研究显示，GPT-5在数学、物理、生物及计算机科学等领域展现出显著的加速作用，能够协助研究人员生成严谨的数学证明、揭示复杂的科学规律并推动跨学科发现。这些案例不仅验证了新一代模型在逻辑推理与知识整合上的进化，也为AI辅助科学研究（AI for Science）提供了新的范式参考。

glossary.explanationZh: 指科学知识的积累与发现过程的推进。
在数学或逻辑学中，通过严密推理得出的结论验证。
指在科学研究中发现新的现象、规律或理论。
